cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay while you tell me why you hid the debt. I used to sit through every difficult answer with you. Someday I need you to risk as much with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not marks. A turn. I've given you somewhere to fall apart; I want you able to sit through my turn too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You used to promise before thinking. An honest 'I don't know' counts as a start. You can owe me the rest.
